question: Select the synonym of **Esoteric**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Mysterious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Esoteric"** means intended for or likely to be understood by only a small number of people with a specialized knowledge or interest. (गूढ़/दुर्गम)

 
 
• **Example: **The professor gave an esoteric lecture that only the graduate students could fully comprehend.
 
 
 
• **"Mysterious"** refers to something that is difficult or impossible to understand, explain, or identify. (रहस्यमय)
 
 
• **Example: **The old house had a mysterious charm that drew curious visitors from far and wide.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that "Mysterious" is a suitable synonym for "Esoteric".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Mysterious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Common** (सामान्य): Refers to something occurring, found, or done often; prevalent.

 
 
• **Example:** It is common to see people commuting by bicycles in this area.
 
 
 
• **Popular** (लोकप्रिय): Liked, admired, or enjoyed by many people or by a particular group.
 
 
• **Example:** This singer is very popular among teenagers.
 
 
 
• **Clear** (स्पष्ट): Easy to perceive, understand, or interpret.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions for the test were very clear and easy to follow.
